title: Trade review 26 Nov: 2 results, 5 lessons
summary: 0 T2, 0 T1, 0 failed today. BHARATFORG bought at ₹1,730.50 (+0.78%); TECHM a missed winner (+4.81%). 95 closed trades total +134.6%.
body_md:
**Trade review, Thu 26 Nov: BHARATFORG bought, TECHM a missed winner; yesterday's entry change is not live yet.**

A quiet day for closed trades: all 95 still total +134.6% (average +1.4%). Nifty rose 0.25% to 25,884.50. 17 trades are running, 11 of them below their buy price, and the average of all 112 bought trades is +1.0%. Three new picks were listed (REDINGTON, LOTUSDEV, ASTRAL), still under the old entry rule. ESCORTS (−6.4%, T1 booked) reaches its 30-day exit tomorrow, Fri 27 Nov.

**Today's results**
- 🟢 **BHARATFORG** (Candle at support, listed 25 Nov): bought: Filled at the zone top ₹1,730.50, 0.3% below the listing close; now +0.78% with no dip yet. An F&O stock in an improving sector, listed with a strong hammer on 0.66× volume. Its low today was only 0.4% under the fill.
- ⚪ **TECHM** (Candle at support, listed 20 Nov): never bought, a missed winner: It came within 1.14% of the zone top (₹1,737.20) but never dipped in. A zone+2% or next-open buy at ₹1,757.00 on 23 Nov would have reached T1 on 25 Nov and T2 since, for +4.81% with no dip. The new entry rule would have bought it.

No trades closed today. Plus 64 earlier. These 74 wins (56 at T2, 18 partial) made +353.0%; with the 21 failures (−218.3% in total, worst MANINDS −24.56%, MOTISONS −22.63% and SMLMAH −18.63%; four of them are liquid ETFs that closed flat) all 95 closed trades total +134.6%. 9 of the 18 partial 'wins' lost money. T1 booked, rest still open (5): PERSISTENT (23 Nov), UNIONBANK and INDIANB (20 Nov), LUPIN (9 Nov) and ESCORTS (28 Oct). 2 of these 5 are below their buy price (ESCORTS −6.4%, INDIANB −0.1%).

**Missed and better entries**
- Missed winners now 24 of 36: TECHM is new tonight. 28 of the 36 never bought came within 2% of the zone.
- Zone up to 2% higher: the gap grew: Fills 94.2% vs 78.1% as listed: 16.1 points (bar 15), up from 15.6. Its 114 closed trades made +174.3%, against +134.6% from 95 real ones. This is the rule changed last night; it is not applied in the scan yet.
- Next day's open: shallower dips and the most money: Worst dip −6.1% vs −7.3% as listed, 1.2 points shallower (the bar is 2). Its 112 closed trades made +203.7% with 22 losing trades.

**Lessons**
- Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list): Their 31 trades average −3.0% (closed and open), and their 26 closed trades net −81.7% with 12 of the 21 failures. Off the list since 4 Nov. The 27 retest near misses logged since then: 7 at T1, 6 at T2, best rise 3.2% on average. (holding)
- Stocks that ran up before listing fail most: 14 of the 17 real failures rose 5% or more in the month before listing. Those 40 trades net −119.5% from 34 closed trades; the other 72 made +254.0% from 61 closed trades, 43 at T2. Still my own 5% split, not a tracker group, so it cannot become a change. (holding)
- Candle-at-support picks are the best group: 39 of 50 bought reached T1 (78%) and 31 reached T2 (62%); their 39 closed trades made +176.6% with 4 failures, and they dip least (−4.0%). (holding)
- F&O stocks do far better than cash stocks: 44 F&O trades: 28 at T2 (64%), worst dip −3.3%. 57 cash trades: 20 at T2 (35%), worst dip −11.4%. (holding)
- (missed) Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners: 24 of 36 never bought would have reached T1 at the next open; 28 of the 36 came within 2% of the zone. TECHM tonight is one more. (holding, acted on)

Early sign, from a tracker group: picks with trigger volume under 1.5× reach T2 less often (41 of 89, 46%; worst dip −7.8%) than those at 1.5–2.5× (10 of 15, 67%). No fixed entry rule tests it, so it stays an early sign. Still true but out of the top 5: picks already in the buy zone at listing always fill (49 of 49).

**Proposed change:** No new change tonight. Last night's change (count a support pick as bought when price comes within 2% above the zone top) is not live yet: no thread has applied it in the scan, so tonight's three new picks were listed under the old rule. Its case grew: the fill gap is now 16.1 points, and TECHM would have been a T2 win. Reply "undo" to drop it before it is applied.

**Bug check:** nothing found. 112 bought = 56 at T2 + 18 partial + 21 failed + 17 running; T1 hit 79 ≥ T2 hit 56; no dates out of order; no duplicates; every closed return matches its fill and exit, and no closed price, date or return changed. The only changes against last night are BHARATFORG's fill, TECHM expiring and the three new listings.
